page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Top: page number centred, with a row of decorative ornaments below it. Then the title block, centred, followed by a large initial Q opening the first paragraph, then a second paragraph running to the foot. Catchword at lower right, gathering signature at lower left.

main_text.head: DE JURE PROTESTANTIUM ORTHODOXORUM contra pontificem Romanum & ejus imperium.
main_text.p: QUæritur, an jure ecclesiæ orthodoxæ protestantes oppugnent pontificem Romanum cum suis seductoribus, & juratis, quos vocant, tam doctoribus, quam auditoribus, qui illius traditiones & idololatriam approbant & tuentur: atq; ab eorum communione sese bonâ cōscientiâ segregarint? Romani pontifici negant. Orthodoxi protestantes affirmant.

Hæc est quæstio comprimis inter orthodoxos & pontificios controver-sia. Nota enim, nos neutiquâ deseruisse ecclesiam, quam Deus sibi in genere humano collegit & servat passim; atque adeo etiam in medio papatus, tum Romæ tum alibi: sed hoc profitemur, nos jure deseruisse, & ab omnibus piis deserendum esse papatum vel papam Romanum cum omnibus suis asseclis & juratis;

page.notes: The initial Q is a large decorative letter joined to "uæritur", transcribed as "QUæritur". The title line "DE JURE PROTESTAN-" is hyphenated across lines ("TIUM ORTHODOXORUM"). The first line of the title block has a line-end hyphen that is kept. The left edge shows bleed-through and partial text from the neighbouring page and the spine, which is not transcribed. Some letters in the body are slightly blurred, notably "seductoribus" and "comprimis"; these are read as printed with no [?] marks because they are reasonably clear at this resolution.
